tagline: 理光数码相机，2010 年发布
description: 理光于2010年推出的数码相机。配备10.7x zoom f=4.9-52.5 mm (like 28-300mm for 35mm film)。快门速度8, 4, 2, 1 - 1/2000 sec.。

specs.传感器: 1/2.3-inch Back-illuminated CMOS sensor(total pixels: approx. 10.60 million pixels).
specs.尺寸: 101.5 mm (W) x 58.6 mm (H) x 29.4 mm (D) (excluding projecting parts)
specs.重量: Approx. 184 g (excluding battery, SD memory card, strap), Accessories approx. 23 g (battery, strap)
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh CX4 has been introduced by Ricoh in 2010.
